paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Distribution of samples (%) across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity.
model_annotation: The figure is a two-ring donut chart showing the distribution of samples across two ambiguity-related measures, with the outer ring representing “Ambiguity Std” and the inner ring representing “Max Ambiguity.” The outer ring has 4 slices, labeled in the legend as Std: 0.0 (dark teal) at about 49.0%, Std: 0.47 (medium blue) at about 39.0%, Std: 0.82 (bright blue) at about 5.0%, and Std: 0.94 (light cyan) at about 7.0%. The inner ring has 3 slices, labeled in the legend as Max: 1 (medium-light blue) at about 47.7%, Max: 2 (lighter blue) at about 38.0%, and Max: 3 (very pale blue) at about 14.2%. Percentage values are printed directly on the corresponding slices, two separate legends are shown on the right for the outer and inner rings, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond color differences.
